AMDconfigurations: Average Membership Degree and AMD curves

Source: R/AMDconfigurations-package.R
AMDconfigurations-package.Rd

AMDconfigurations computes Average Membership Degree (AMD) from a soft-membership matrix and constructs AMD curves over candidate numbers of configurations. The AMD definition is independent of the algorithm used to estimate memberships; the current curve backend uses repeated fuzzy c-means. The package keeps score calculation, curve construction, interpretation and final assignment as distinct operations.

References

Mendoza, M. and Araújo, M. B. (2022). Biogeography of bird and mammal trophic structures. Ecography, 2022(5), e06289. doi:10.1111/ecog.06289
